Groww Mutual Fund, a leading fund house, is renowned for its innovative approach to delivering investment solutions. It specializes in a broad array of financial products tailored to meet the distinct needs and aspirations of its investors.
The philosophy of Groww Mutual Fund is built upon the pillars of simplicity, transparency, consistent wealth creation, and customer centricity. They are focused on identifying investment opportunities where high growth aligns with robust fundamentals.
Operating under the trusteeship of Groww Trustee Limited and sponsored by Groww Invest Tech Pvt Ltd, Groww Mutual Fund offers a diverse portfolio. The portfolio encompasses a wide range of investment schemes, including equity funds, hybrid funds, debt funds, and ETFs.

How can you invest in Groww Mutual Funds?
by following some simple steps. Mentioned below is the process to invest in this mutual fund.
Step 1. Log-in to your Groww account to access the necessary information. If you are a new user, register your details to create an account.
Step 2. Upload a copy of your Identity Proof, like Voter ID, Aadhaar, PAN Card, passport, Driving Licence, etc. It should be a document issued by the Central or State Government.
Step 3. Upload a Proof of Address document. It can be any identity proof document with your permanent address mentioned.
Step 4. Choose an appropriate investment period for the scheme.
Step 5. Select whether you want to invest in a low, medium, or high-risk scheme.
Step 6. Set your preferred mutual fund as
Step 7. Select “Invest One Time” if you want to invest a large amount; select “Start SIP” if you want to invest the amount via SIP.
investment will reflect in your Groww account within 3 to 4 business days after the completion of the process.
